title: 第1026章 真实目的终极实验第1025章 集合蓝图理论论证
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
黑袍顾问的话像一颗投入死水的石子，在议事厅的灯火通明中激起了无声的涟漪。
宋知意翻动全息屏的手指停在了半空中。
白无尘的呼吸乱了。
他从这位黑袍顾问开口说第一句话时就觉得不对劲，此刻那种不对劲的感觉终于凝聚成了一个确切的判断——这个人的思维方式和苏墨如出一辙，都是从最坏的可能性出发，一层层剥开敌人的外壳，直到看见那颗最黑暗的核。
“实验设计的一部分……”
铁临渊将这几个字在干涩的唇齿间反复碾磨，那双浑浊的老眼中骤然闪过一丝极深的忌惮，“你的意思是，连母巢本身都是古青殿的实验变量？”
黑袍顾问微微偏头，兜帽下那截苍白的下巴转向苏墨的方向：“林团长刚才说，黑袍虚影在摧毁母巢时表现得过于从容，从容到好像母巢被毁也是他计划的一部分。
如果母巢本身就是实验设计的一部分，那他的从容就不需要解释了——他只是在按计划行事，而不是随机应变。”
他顿了顿，将双手从袖中抽出，交叠在桌面上。
那双手苍白得没有一丝血色，手指修长而骨节分明，指甲修剪得整整齐齐，怎么看都不像是一双握剑的手。
但苏墨的目光却在他左手无名指的指根处停了下来。
那里有一圈极淡极细的疤痕，像是曾经佩戴过某枚戒指，在漫长岁月中被反复取下又戴上，最终在皮肤上留下了一道永远褪不去的印记。
“母巢的存在，从一开始就不是偶然。”
黑袍顾问继续道，声音依旧是那种被刻意模糊了声纹特征的平淡语调，“你们想想，尸鬼病毒的核心特性之一是什么？是在达成一定密度后自行构建蜂巢网络，形成集体意识。
这不是病毒的随机变异，这是被事先编入病毒底层架构的核心功能。”
“也就是说，只要有足够多的感染者聚集在同一个区域，就一定会产生母巢。
母巢不是变异出来的新品种，它是病毒内置的必然产物。”
宋知意的瞳孔微微收缩。
她飞快地调出苏墨之前传给她的病毒结构图谱，手指在全息屏上快速滑动，将蜂巢意识模块的数据从底层架构中单独提取出来。
数据的结构逻辑清晰得可怕——这不像是病毒在自然界中随机变异出来的功能，每一个子模块的编码都严丝合缝地嵌套在核心链路之中，与周围的生命逆转模块、灵能传播模块形成完美的协同结构。

“如果母巢是病毒内置的功能，”
宋知意开口，声音里第一次出现了一丝无法掩饰的凝重，“那么黑袍虚影说母巢是‘失败的实验’，显然就是在撒谎。
母巢根本不是什么实验偏差，它是古青殿预设的实验阶段。”
“阶段性的实验节点。”
黑袍顾问微微颔首，似乎在认可宋知意的推论，“那么问题来了——母巢作为实验阶段，它的实验目的是什么？”
content_en:
The black-robed advisor's words were like a pebble thrown into stagnant water, causing silent ripples in the bright lights of the chamber.
Song Zhiyi's finger flipping through the holographic screen stopped in mid-air.
Bai Wuchen's breathing was messed up.
He felt something was wrong from the first words spoken by the black-robed consultant. At this moment, the feeling of something wrong finally condensed into a definite judgment - this person's way of thinking was exactly the same as Su Mo's, starting from the worst possibility, peeling off the enemy's shell layer by layer until he saw the darkest core.
"Part of the experimental design..."
Tie Linyuan grinded these words repeatedly between his dry lips and teeth, and a trace of deep fear suddenly flashed through his turbid old eyes, "You mean, even the Brood itself is an experimental variable of the Ancient Qing Palace?"
The black-robed consultant tilted his head slightly, and the pale chin under the hood turned in the direction of Su Mo: "Captain Lin just said that the black-robed shadow acted too calmly when destroying the brood, so calmly that it seemed that the destruction of the brood was part of his plan.
If the brood itself was part of the experimental design, then his calmness would need no explanation—he was simply following a plan, not improvising. "
He paused, took his hands out of his sleeves, and folded them on the table.
The hands were so pale that there was no trace of blood, the fingers were long and well-defined, and the nails were neatly trimmed. They didn't look like a pair of hands holding a sword.
But Su Mo's eyes stopped at the base of the ring finger of his left hand.
There was a circle of very light and thin scars there, as if a certain ring had been worn and repeatedly taken off and put on again over the long years, eventually leaving a mark on the skin that would never fade away.
"The existence of the Brood was no accident from the beginning."
The black-robed consultant continued, his voice still in a calm tone with the voiceprint characteristics deliberately blurred, "Think about it, what is one of the core characteristics of the ghoul virus? It is to build a honeycomb network on its own after reaching a certain density to form a collective consciousness.
This is not a random mutation of the virus, this is a core function programmed into the underlying architecture of the virus. "
“In other words, as long as enough infected people gather in the same area, a mother nest will definitely be formed.
The mother nest is not a new species that has mutated, it is an inevitable product built into the virus. "
Song Zhiyi's pupils shrank slightly.
She quickly called up the virus structure map that Su Mo had given her before, and quickly slid her fingers on the holographic screen to extract the data of the hive consciousness module separately from the underlying architecture.
The structural logic of the data is frighteningly clear - it is not like the function of a virus randomly mutating in nature. The coding of each sub-module is tightly nested in the core link, forming a perfect collaborative structure with the surrounding life reversal module and psychic energy transmission module.
"If the mother nest is a built-in function of the virus,"
Song Zhiyi spoke, and for the first time there was a hint of solemnity in his voice that could not be concealed, "Then the black-robed shadow said that the Brood is a 'failed experiment', which is obviously a lie.
The Brood is not an experimental deviation at all, it is the experimental stage preset by Gu Qingdian. "
"A phased experimental node."
The black-robed consultant nodded slightly, seeming to agree with Song Zhiyi's inference, "Then the question is - as the brood is in the experimental stage, what is its experimental purpose?"
